title: Sog‘lom turmush tarzi: ovqatlanish, sport, uyqu va maslahat
goal_uz: Dars oxirida ovqatlanish, sport va uyqu haqida to‘g‘ri birikmalar bilan gapirasiz, kamida besh xil tuzilma bilan maslahat berasiz, odatlar va o‘zgarishlarni “used to” va frazali fe’llar bilan tasvirlaysiz hamda sabab va natijani to‘g‘ri bog‘lovchilar bilan bog‘laysiz.

scenes.title: Sog‘lom turmush tarzi
scenes.say_native: Assalomu alaykum! Yana bir darsga xush kelibsiz. Oldingi darsda texnologiya kundalik hayotimizni qanday o‘zgartirayotgani haqida gaplashdik. Bugun esa juda shaxsiy va foydali mavzu: sog‘lom turmush tarzi. Ovqatlanish, sport va uyqu haqidagi lug‘atni o‘rganamiz, maslahat berishni, odatlar va o‘zgarishlar haqida gapirishni hamda sabab va natijani bog‘lashni mashq qilamiz. Dars oxirida do‘stingizga sog‘lomroq yashash bo‘yicha bir daqiqalik aniq maslahat bera olasiz.
scenes.say: Welcome back! Today we're talking about healthy living: what we eat, how we move and how well we sleep. By the end of the lesson, you'll be able to describe your habits, explain why they matter and give someone useful advice.
scenes.say_uz: Yana xush kelibsiz! Bugun sog‘lom turmush tarzi haqida gaplashamiz: nima yeymiz, qanchalik harakat qilamiz va qanchalik yaxshi uxlaymiz. Dars oxirida odatlaringizni tasvirlay olasiz, ular nima uchun muhimligini tushuntira olasiz va kimgadir foydali maslahat bera olasiz.

scenes.title: Ovqatlanish: asosiy so‘zlar
board: junk food / processed food (zararli / qayta ishlangan ovqat)

examples.t: I try to have a balanced diet.
He eats too much junk food.
examples.uz: U juda ko‘p zararli ovqat yeydi.

scenes.say_native: Avval ovqatlanish lug‘ati. Ingliz tilida “diet” so‘zi faqat ozish uchun parhez emas, balki odam odatda nima yeyishini ham bildiradi. Shuning uchun “a balanced diet” — muvozanatli ovqatlanish, “a healthy diet” — sog‘lom ovqatlanish. Ozish uchun parhez haqida gapirsak, “to be on a diet” deymiz. “Junk food” — chips, gazli ichimlik, fast-fud kabi zararli ovqatlar. “Processed food” — zavodda qayta ishlangan, konservantli mahsulotlar. “Portion” — bir porsiya, bir likopcha ovqat miqdori.
scenes.say: A balanced diet means eating a bit of everything: plenty of fresh fruit and vegetables, some protein, and not too much sugar or fat. Junk food is tasty, but it's full of salt, sugar and fat. If you're on a diet, you're trying to lose weight.
scenes.say_uz: Muvozanatli ovqatlanish hamma narsadan ozroq yeyish demakdir: ko‘p yangi meva va sabzavotlar, biroz oqsil va juda ko‘p bo‘lmagan shakar yoki yog‘. Zararli ovqat mazali, lekin tuz, shakar va yog‘ga to‘la. Agar siz parhezda bo‘lsangiz, vazn yo‘qotishga harakat qilyapsiz.

scenes.title: Oziq moddalar va sanaladigan otlar
board: too much sugar / too many sweets
eat healthily · drink plenty of water

examples.t: You don't get enough fibre.
I eat too many sweets.

scenes.say_native: Oziq moddalar: “protein” — oqsil, “fibre” — kletchatka, Amerikada “fiber” deb yoziladi, “vitamins” — vitaminlar. Muhim grammatik nuqta: “sugar”, “salt”, “fat”, “water” sanalmaydigan otlar, shuning uchun “too much sugar”, “a lot of salt” deymiz. “Sweets” esa sanaladi, shuning uchun “too many sweets”. Yana bir nozik joy: fe’l bilan ravish ishlatiladi — “eat healthily”, sog‘lom ovqatlanmoq. “Eat healthy” Amerikada og‘zaki nutqda eshitiladi, lekin yozuvda “healthily” to‘g‘ri.
scenes.say: Your body needs protein, fibre and vitamins. Try not to have too much sugar or salt, and don't eat too many sweets. Drink plenty of water and eat healthily, and you'll feel the difference.
scenes.say_uz: Tanangizga oqsil, kletchatka va vitaminlar kerak. Juda ko‘p shakar yoki tuz iste’mol qilmaslikka harakat qiling va juda ko‘p shirinlik yemang. Ko‘p suv iching va sog‘lom ovqatlaning, shunda farqni sezasiz.

scenes.title: Sport va harakat
board: go running / go swimming / go to the gym
keep fit / stay in shape (sog‘lom va chaqqon bo‘lmoq)

examples.t: I work out three times a week.
Swimming helps me keep fit.
examples.uz: Suzish menga sog‘lom va baquvvat bo‘lishga yordam beradi.

scenes.say_native: Endi sport. “Do exercise” yoki “work out” — mashq qilmoq, odatda sport zalida. “Go” fe’li “-ing” bilan tugaydigan faoliyatlar bilan keladi: “go running”, “go swimming”, “go cycling”. To‘p bilan o‘ynaladigan o‘yinlarda “play” ishlatiladi: “play football”, “play tennis”. “Do” esa “do yoga”, “do karate”, “do exercise” bilan keladi. “Keep fit” va “stay in shape” — doim sog‘lom, chaqqon holatda bo‘lish. O‘zbek tilida hammasiga “sport bilan shug‘ullanmoq” deymiz, ingliz tilida esa fe’lni to‘g‘ri tanlash kerak.
scenes.say: I go running every morning, I play football with my friends at the weekend, and I do yoga on Wednesdays. Working out regularly helps me stay in shape and gives me more energy.
scenes.say_uz: Har tong yuguraman, dam olish kunlari do‘stlarim bilan futbol o‘ynayman, chorshanba kunlari yoga qilaman. Muntazam mashq qilish menga sog‘lom holatni saqlashga yordam beradi va ko‘proq quvvat beradi.

scenes.title: Make sport emas
board: ✓ I do sport / I do exercise every day.
✗ I go to football. → ✓ I play football.
✗ I play yoga. → ✓ I do yoga.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbek tilida so‘zlashuvchilar ko‘p qiladigan xato: rus tilidagi “заниматься спортом” yoki o‘zbekcha “sport qilmoq” ta’sirida “make sport” deyish. Ingliz tilida bunday birikma yo‘q. Britaniyada “do sport”, umumiy holda “do exercise” deymiz. Ikkinchi xato: “I go to football”. Agar o‘zingiz o‘ynasangiz, “I play football”. “Go to football” faqat o‘yinni tomosha qilishga borishni bildirishi mumkin. Uchinchi xato: “play yoga”. Yoga o‘yin emas, shuning uchun “do yoga”.
scenes.say: Not 'make sport', but 'do sport' or 'do exercise'. We play football, we do yoga, and we go swimming.
scenes.say_uz: “Make sport” emas, “do sport” yoki “do exercise”. Futbolni “play”, yogani “do”, suzishni esa “go swimming” deymiz.

scenes.title: Uyqu lug‘ati
board: get enough sleep · a good night's sleep
go to bed early · stay up late

examples.t: I stayed up late last night.
I couldn't fall asleep.

scenes.say_native: Uyqu haqida. “Get enough sleep” — yetarlicha uxlamoq. “A good night’s sleep” — tunda yaxshilab uxlash. “Go to bed” — yotmoq, to‘shakka kirmoq; “fall asleep” — uxlab qolmoq, ya’ni ko‘z yumilib uyquga ketish. Bu ikki fe’l farqli: soat o‘n birda yotib, birda uxlab qolishingiz mumkin. “Stay up late” — kechgacha uxlamay o‘tirmoq. “Oversleep” — uyg‘onolmay qolib, kechikmoq; o‘tgan zamoni “overslept”. “Wake up” — uyg‘onmoq, “get up” — o‘rindan turmoq.
scenes.say: Most adults need seven to nine hours of sleep. If you stay up late scrolling on your phone, it's harder to fall asleep, and you might oversleep the next morning.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchilik kattalarga yetti-to‘qqiz soat uyqu kerak. Agar kechgacha telefoningizni varaqlab o‘tirsangiz, uxlab qolish qiyinlashadi va ertasi kuni ertalab uyg‘onolmay qolishingiz mumkin.

scenes.title: Uxlamoq: sleep, go to bed, fall asleep
board: ✓ Yesterday I went to bed at 12.
✓ I fell asleep at about one.
✗ I sleep 7 hours. → ✓ I sleep for 7 hours / I get 7 hours' sleep.
scenes.say_native: O‘zbekcha “soat o‘n ikkida uxladim” degan gapni so‘zma-so‘z “I slept at 12” deb tarjima qilish xato. “Sleep” jarayonni bildiradi, aniq vaqt nuqtasini emas. Yotgan vaqtingizni aytsangiz — “I went to bed at 12”, uyquga ketgan paytingizni aytsangiz — “I fell asleep at one”. Davomiylik uchun esa “I sleep for seven hours” yoki tabiiyroq “I get seven hours’ sleep” deymiz. Bu xatoni tuzatsangiz, nutqingiz ancha tabiiy eshitiladi.
scenes.say: I went to bed at midnight, but I didn't fall asleep until one. So I only got six hours' sleep.
scenes.say_uz: Yarim tunda yotdim, lekin soat birgacha uxlay olmadim. Shuning uchun faqat olti soat uxladim.

scenes.title: To‘g‘ri fe’lni tanlang
board: 3) I ___ to bed at 11 but ___ asleep at 1.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Ekrandagi to‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchi va ikkinchi gapda “go”, “play” yoki “do” dan birini tanlang. Uchinchi gapda ikkita fe’l kerak, o‘tgan zamonda. To‘rtinchisida zararli ovqat uchun o‘rgangan so‘zimizni qo‘ying. Gaplarni baland ovozda to‘liq ayting.
scenes.say: One: I blank swimming twice a week. Two: She blank yoga every morning. Three: I blank to bed at eleven but blank asleep at one. Four: Try to eat less blank food.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Haftada ikki marta ... suzishga. Ikki: U har tong yoga ... . Uch: Soat 11 da ... yotdim, lekin soat birda ... uxladim. To‘rt: Kamroq ... ovqat yeyishga harakat qiling.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 3) I went to bed … but fell asleep at 1
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I go swimming”, chunki “-ing” bilan tugaydigan faoliyat “go” bilan keladi. Ikkinchi: “She does yoga”, uchinchi shaxs birlikda “does”. Uchinchi: “I went to bed at eleven but fell asleep at one”, “fall” noto‘g‘ri fe’l, o‘tgan zamoni “fell”. To‘rtinchi: “junk food” yoki “processed food”. Diqqat qiling: “food” bu yerda sanalmaydi, shuning uchun “less” to‘g‘ri, “fewer” emas.
scenes.say: I go swimming twice a week. She does yoga every morning. I went to bed at eleven but fell asleep at one. Try to eat less junk food.
scenes.say_uz: Haftada ikki marta suzishga boraman. U har tong yoga qiladi. Soat 11 da yotdim, lekin soat birda uxlab qoldim. Kamroq zararli ovqat yeyishga harakat qiling.

scenes.title: Maslahat: should / shouldn’t

examples.t: You should get more sleep.
Should I see a doctor?

scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi asosiy mavzu: maslahat berish. Eng ko‘p ishlatiladigan vosita — “should”. Qoida juda oddiy: “should” dan keyin fe’l “to” siz, asosiy shaklda keladi va shaxsga qarab o‘zgarmaydi: “I should”, “she should”. Inkori “shouldn’t”, so‘roqda “should” egadan oldinga chiqadi: “Should I see a doctor?” O‘zbek tilida biz buni “-ishingiz kerak” yoki “-sangiz yaxshi bo‘lardi” deb aytamiz. “Should” buyruq emas, do‘stona maslahat, shuning uchun u muloyim eshitiladi.
scenes.say: You look tired. You should get more sleep, and you shouldn't drink coffee after six. Should I go to bed earlier? Yes, you should.
scenes.say_uz: Charchagan ko‘rinasiz. Ko‘proq uxlashingiz kerak va soat oltidan keyin qahva ichmasligingiz kerak. Ertaroq yotishim kerakmi? Ha, kerak.

scenes.title: Kuchliroq maslahat: ought to va had better

examples.t: You ought to eat more vegetables.
You'd better see a doctor.
examples.uz: Yaxshisi, shifokorga boring (aks holda yomon bo‘ladi).

scenes.say_native: “Ought to” ma’nosi “should” bilan deyarli bir xil, faqat kamroq ishlatiladi va biroz rasmiyroq eshitiladi. Bu yerda “to” majburiy: “You ought to rest”. “Had better”, qisqa shakli “’d better”, kuchliroq: u “aks holda muammo bo‘ladi” degan ogohlantirishni bildiradi. Diqqat: shakli “had” bo‘lsa ham, o‘tgan zamon emas, hozir va kelajak haqida. Inkori “You’d better not”. Notanish odamga yoki rahbarga “you’d better” deyish qo‘pol eshitilishi mumkin, uni ehtiyotkorlik bilan ishlating.
scenes.say: You ought to eat more vegetables. That cough sounds bad; you'd better see a doctor. And you'd better not go to work tomorrow.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘proq sabzavot yeyishingiz kerak. Bu yo‘tal yomon eshitilyapti, yaxshisi shifokorga boring. Va yaxshisi ertaga ishga bormang.

scenes.title: Muloyim maslahat iboralari
board: If I were you, I'd + fe’l…
It's a good idea to + fe’l

examples.t: Why don't you try walking to work?
If I were you, I'd cut down on sugar.
examples.uz: Men sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lganimda, shakarni kamaytirgan bo‘lardim.

scenes.say_native: Ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar maslahatni ko‘pincha yanada yumshoqroq beradi. “Why don’t you…?” — so‘roq shaklida, lekin aslida taklif: “Why don’t you try yoga?” “How about” yoki “What about” dan keyin “-ing” shakl keladi: “How about going for a walk?” “If I were you, I’d…” — men sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, … qilardim. Bu yerda “were” barcha shaxslar uchun ishlatiladi, bu qotib qolgan ibora. “It’s a good idea to…” esa umumiy maslahat. Bu iboralar nutqingizni xilma-xil qiladi.
scenes.say: Why don't you try walking to work? How about going to bed half an hour earlier? If I were you, I'd stop drinking energy drinks. It's a good idea to keep a bottle of water on your desk.
scenes.say_uz: Nega ishga piyoda borib ko‘rmaysiz? Yarim soat ertaroq yotsangiz-chi? Men sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, energetik ichimliklarni ichishni to‘xtatardim. Stolingizda bir shisha suv saqlash yaxshi fikr.

scenes.title: O‘zbekcha bilan solishtirish
board: Men bo‘lganimda… → If I were you, I'd…

examples.t: Ko‘proq dam olsangiz-chi?
Men bo‘lsam, chekishni tashlardim.
examples.uz: If I were you, I'd give up smoking.

scenes.say_native: Keling, o‘zbek tili bilan solishtiraylik. Biz “dam olishingiz kerak” deganda ingliz tilida “You should rest” to‘g‘ri keladi. “Dam olsangiz-chi?” degan yumshoq taklif esa “Why don’t you rest?” yoki “How about resting?” bo‘ladi. Diqqat qiling: o‘zbek tilida “kerak” ham maslahat, ham majburiyat bo‘lishi mumkin. Ingliz tilida majburiyat uchun “must” yoki “have to” ishlatiladi. Shuning uchun do‘stingizga “You must sleep more” desangiz, buyruqdek qattiq eshitiladi. Maslahatda “should” xavfsiz tanlov.
scenes.say: You should rest. Why don't you rest? How about resting? If I were you, I'd rest. Four ways to give the same advice.
scenes.say_uz: Dam olishingiz kerak. Nega dam olmaysiz? Dam olsangiz-chi? Men sizning o‘rningizda dam olardim. Bir xil maslahatning to‘rt xil usuli.

scenes.title: Maslahatdagi tipik xatolar
board: ✗ You should to drink more water. → ✓ You should drink…
✗ How about go for a walk? → ✓ How about going…?
✗ You ought eat less. → ✓ You ought to eat less.
✗ You had better to stop. → ✓ You'd better stop.
scenes.say_native: Endi eng ko‘p uchraydigan xatolar. Birinchisi: “should” dan keyin “to” qo‘yish. “Should”, “must”, “can”, “had better” dan keyin “to” bo‘lmaydi. Ikkinchisi: “How about go…”. “About” predlog, predlogdan keyin esa fe’l “-ing” shaklda keladi: “How about going”. Uchinchisi teskari: “ought” dan keyin “to” albatta kerak. To‘rtinchisi: “had better to”. Eslab qoling: faqat “ought to” da “to” bor, qolganlarida yo‘q.
scenes.say: You should drink more water. How about going for a walk? You ought to eat less salt. You'd better stop smoking.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘proq suv ichishingiz kerak. Sayr qilsangiz-chi? Kamroq tuz yeyishingiz kerak. Yaxshisi chekishni tashlang.

scenes.title: Talaffuz: should va 'd better
scenes.say_native: Talaffuz. “Should” so‘zida “l” harfi umuman o‘qilmaydi. Gap ichida u odatda kuchsiz shaklda, tez va qisqa aytiladi: “You should go” — /ʃəd/. Qisqa javobda esa to‘liq va urg‘uli: “Yes, you should” — /ʃʊd/. “Shouldn’t” da ham “l” yo‘q, oxiridagi “t” ko‘pincha yengil aytiladi. “You’d better” da “’d” juda qisqa, ba’zan deyarli eshitilmaydi, shuning uchun tinglaganda “you better” ga o‘xshab ketadi. “Ought to” ni bir so‘zdek, “ota” ga yaqin aytamiz.
scenes.say: You should go. Yes, you should. You shouldn't worry. You'd better hurry. You ought to try it.
scenes.say_uz: Borishingiz kerak. Ha, kerak. Xavotir olmasligingiz kerak. Yaxshisi, shoshiling. Buni sinab ko‘rishingiz kerak.

scenes.title: Maslahat bering
board: 2) I eat fast food every day. (If I were you…)
3) I never do any exercise. (Why don't you…?)
4) I have a terrible toothache. ('d better)
scenes.say_native: Endi siz maslahat berasiz. Ekranda to‘rtta muammo va qavs ichida qaysi iborani ishlatish kerakligi yozilgan. Har biriga bitta to‘liq gap bilan maslahat bering. Grammatikaga e’tibor bering: “should” va “’d better” dan keyin “to” yo‘q, “If I were you” dan keyin “I’d” keladi.
scenes.say: One: I'm always tired. Two: I eat fast food every day. Three: I never do any exercise. Four: I have a terrible toothache. What's your advice?
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Doim charchayman. Ikki: Har kuni fast-fud yeyman. Uch: Hech qachon mashq qilmayman. To‘rt: Tishim qattiq og‘riyapti. Sizning maslahatingiz qanday?

scenes.title: Namuna javoblar
board: 1) You should go to bed earlier.
2) If I were you, I'd cook at home more often.
3) Why don't you go for a walk after work?
scenes.say_native: Namuna javoblar. Birinchi: “You should go to bed earlier”. Ikkinchi: “If I were you, I’d cook at home more often”. Uchinchi: “Why don’t you go for a walk after work?” To‘rtinchi: “You’d better see a dentist”, ya’ni yaxshisi tish shifokoriga boring, aks holda og‘riq kuchayadi. Sizning maslahatingiz boshqacha bo‘lishi mumkin, muhimi tuzilma to‘g‘ri bo‘lsin. Ayniqsa “why don’t you” dan keyin fe’l “to” siz kelishini tekshiring.
scenes.say: You should go to bed earlier. If I were you, I'd cook at home more often. Why don't you go for a walk after work? You'd better see a dentist.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaroq yotishingiz kerak. Men sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, uyda tez-tez ovqat pishirardim. Nega ishdan keyin sayrga chiqmaysiz? Yaxshisi, tish shifokoriga boring.

scenes.title: Dialog 1: Shifokor qabulida
board: What three pieces of advice does he get?
scenes.say_native: Endi birinchi dialogni tinglang. Aziz ismli yigit shifokorga keldi. U nimadan shikoyat qilyapti va shifokor unga qanday uchta maslahat beryapti? Ekrandagi ikki savolni yodda tuting va diqqat bilan tinglang. Maslahat iboralarini ham ilg‘ab olishga harakat qiling: shifokor uch xil tuzilma ishlatadi. Bir narsani oldindan aytib qo‘yay: “exhausted” so‘zi juda charchagan, holdan toygan degani.
scenes.say: Doctor: So, what seems to be the problem? Aziz: I've been getting headaches, and I feel exhausted all the time. Doctor: How much sleep do you get? Aziz: About five hours. I usually stay up late working. Doctor: That's not enough. You should aim for at least seven. And how much water do you drink? Aziz: Not much, mostly coffee. Doctor: You'd better cut down on coffee, then. And why don't you take a short walk at lunchtime? Fresh air really helps.
scenes.say_uz: Shifokor: Xo‘sh, muammo nimada? Aziz: Boshim og‘riyapti va doim juda charchagan holdaman. Shifokor: Qancha uxlaysiz? Aziz: Taxminan besh soat. Odatda kechgacha ishlab o‘tiraman. Shifokor: Bu yetarli emas. Kamida yetti soat uxlashga harakat qiling. Qancha suv ichasiz? Aziz: Ko‘p emas, asosan qahva. Shifokor: Unda yaxshisi qahvani kamaytiring. Va nega tushlik paytida qisqa sayr qilmaysiz? Toza havo juda yordam beradi.

scenes.title: Dialog bo‘yicha savollar
board: 3) What does he drink instead of water?
4) What are the three pieces of advice?
scenes.say_native: To‘rtta savolga javob bering. Azizning ikki muammosi nima? Nega u yetarlicha uxlamaydi? Suv o‘rniga nima ichadi? Shifokor qanday uchta maslahat berdi? Javoblarni inglizcha, to‘liq gap bilan aytishga harakat qiling. Maslahatlarni aytganda shifokorning o‘z iboralarini takrorlang, masalan “He should…” yoki “He’d better…”.
scenes.say: What are Aziz's two problems? Why doesn't he sleep enough? What does he drink instead of water? What are the three pieces of advice?
scenes.say_uz: Azizning ikki muammosi nima? Nega u yetarlicha uxlamaydi? Suv o‘rniga nima ichadi? Uchta maslahat qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 1
board: 4) sleep 7+ hours · cut down on coffee · walk at lunchtime
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: uning boshi og‘riyapti va doim juda charchagan, “exhausted” — “tired” ning kuchli shakli. Ikkinchi: u kechgacha ishlab o‘tiradi, “he stays up late working”. Uchinchi: asosan qahva ichadi. To‘rtinchi: kamida yetti soat uxlash, qahvani kamaytirish va tushlikda qisqa sayr qilish. E’tibor bering, shifokor uch xil ibora ishlatdi: “You should”, “You’d better” va “Why don’t you”.
scenes.say: He has headaches and feels exhausted. He stays up late working. He drinks mostly coffee. The doctor tells him to sleep at least seven hours, cut down on coffee and take a walk at lunchtime.
scenes.say_uz: Uning boshi og‘riydi va juda charchagan. U kechgacha ishlab o‘tiradi. Asosan qahva ichadi. Shifokor unga kamida yetti soat uxlashni, qahvani kamaytirishni va tushlikda sayr qilishni aytadi.

scenes.title: Odatlar: hozirgi oddiy zamon
board: always · usually · often · sometimes · rarely · never
I tend to eat late. (odatim bor)

examples.t: I rarely eat fast food.
I tend to skip breakfast.

scenes.say_native: Uchinchi mavzu: odatlar va o‘zgarishlar. Doimiy odatlar haqida hozirgi oddiy zamonda va chastota ravishlari bilan gapiramiz. Ravish asosiy fe’ldan oldin, lekin “be” fe’lidan keyin turadi: “I usually walk”, lekin “I’m usually tired”. Yana bir foydali ibora: “tend to” — “odatim bor, ko‘pincha shunday qilaman”. “I tend to eat late” — kech ovqatlanish odatim bor. “Habit” — odat: “a healthy habit”, “a bad habit”. “Skip breakfast” — nonushtani o‘tkazib yubormoq.
scenes.say: I usually get up at seven, and I always have breakfast. I'm rarely ill. But I have one bad habit: I tend to eat late in the evening.
scenes.say_uz: Odatda soat yettida turaman va doim nonushta qilaman. Kamdan-kam kasal bo‘laman. Lekin bitta yomon odatim bor: kechqurun kech ovqatlanishga moyilman.

scenes.title: O‘zgarishlar: frazali fe’llar

examples.t: I gave up sugar last year.
She's taken up running.

scenes.say_native: O‘zgarishlar haqida gapirish uchun frazali fe’llar juda kerak. “Give up” — butunlay tashlamoq: “give up smoking”. “Cut down on” — kamaytirmoq: “cut down on sugar”. “Take up” — yangi sport yoki hobbi boshlamoq: “take up swimming”. “Switch to” — boshqasiga o‘tmoq: “I switched to green tea”. “Get into the habit of” — odat qilib olmoq, keyin “-ing”: “I got into the habit of walking”. Teskarisi “break a habit” — odatdan qutulmoq. “Give up” va “take up” dan keyin ham fe’l bo‘lsa, “-ing” shaklda keladi.
scenes.say: Last year I decided to change my life. I gave up smoking, cut down on sugar and took up swimming. I also switched from coffee to green tea, and I got into the habit of walking after dinner.
scenes.say_uz: O‘tgan yili hayotimni o‘zgartirishga qaror qildim. Chekishni tashladim, shakarni kamaytirdim va suzishni boshladim. Shuningdek, qahvadan ko‘k choyga o‘tdim va kechki ovqatdan keyin sayr qilishni odat qilib oldim.

scenes.title: Used to: oldin, endi emas
board: used to + fe’l = oldin odat edi, endi yo‘q
I used to eat a lot of sweets.

examples.t: I used to smoke, but I gave up.
We didn't use to cook at home.

scenes.say_native: O‘tmishdagi, hozir mavjud bo‘lmagan odatlar uchun “used to” ishlatiladi. O‘zbek tilida buni “-ardim”, “oldin … edim” deb aytamiz: “Oldin ko‘p shirinlik yerdim” — “I used to eat a lot of sweets”. Inkor va so‘roqda “did” yordamchi fe’li bor, shuning uchun “used” emas, “use” yoziladi: “I didn’t use to”, “Did you use to?” Talaffuzda “used to” /ˈjuːstə/ deb, bitta tovushdek aytiladi, “d” eshitilmaydi. “Used to” faqat o‘tmish uchun, hozirgi zamon shakli yo‘q.
scenes.say: I used to eat a lot of sweets and I didn't use to exercise at all. Now I eat fruit instead and go to the gym. Did you use to have any bad habits?
scenes.say_uz: Oldin ko‘p shirinlik yerdim va umuman mashq qilmasdim. Endi o‘rniga meva yeyman va sport zaliga boraman. Sizning oldin biror yomon odatingiz bormidi?

scenes.title: Stop to do va stop doing
board: ✗ I use to drink cola every day.
✓ I usually drink… / ✓ I used to drink… (oldin)
stop to smoke = chekish uchun to‘xtamoq!
scenes.say_native: Ikki muhim xato. Birinchisi: hozirgi odat uchun “I use to” deyish. Bunday shakl yo‘q. Hozirgi odat uchun “I usually drink”, oldingi odat uchun “I used to drink”. Ikkinchisi juda qiziq: “stop” dan keyin “-ing” va “to” ma’noni butunlay o‘zgartiradi. “I stopped smoking” — chekishni tashladim. “I stopped to smoke” esa — chekish uchun bir joyda to‘xtadim, ya’ni teskari ma’no! Shifokorga “I stopped to eat sugar” desangiz, u sizni noto‘g‘ri tushunadi.
scenes.say: I stopped smoking two years ago. On the way home, I stopped to buy some fruit.
scenes.say_uz: Ikki yil oldin chekishni tashladim. Uyga ketayotib, meva sotib olish uchun to‘xtadim.

scenes.title: O‘zgarish haqida: present perfect

examples.t: I've lost three kilos since March.
examples.uz: Martdan beri uch kilo vazn yo‘qotdim.

examples.t: I've been feeling much better lately.
examples.uz: So‘nggi paytda o‘zimni ancha yaxshi his qilyapman.

scenes.say_native: O‘zgarishning natijasi hozir sezilayotgan bo‘lsa, present perfect ishlatamiz. “I’ve lost three kilos” — uch kilo yo‘qotdim va hozir yengilroqman. Davom etayotgan jarayon uchun present perfect continuous: “I’ve been sleeping better since I stopped using my phone in bed”. Vaqt uchun “since” aniq boshlanish nuqtasi bilan, “for” esa davomiylik bilan keladi: “since January”, “for two months”. O‘zbek tilida “beri” ikkalasiga ham mos keladi, shuning uchun ehtiyot bo‘ling.
scenes.say: I've started cycling to work and I've lost three kilos since March. I've been sleeping much better for the last two months.
scenes.say_uz: Ishga velosipedda borishni boshladim va martdan beri uch kilo yo‘qotdim. So‘nggi ikki oydan beri ancha yaxshi uxlayapman.

scenes.title: Gaplarni to‘ldiring
board: 1) I ___ (used to / use to) play football, but now I don't.
2) My dad gave ___ smoking last year.
3) I want to cut down ___ coffee.
scenes.say_native: Mashq. To‘rtta gapni to‘ldiring. Birinchisida to‘g‘ri shaklni tanlang. Ikkinchi va uchinchisida frazali fe’lning yetishmayotgan qismini ayting. To‘rtinchisida ma’noga e’tibor bering: u go‘sht yeyishni butunlay tashladi. Javoblaringizni baland ovozda ayting.
scenes.say: One: I blank play football, but now I don't. Two: My dad gave blank smoking last year. Three: I want to cut down blank coffee. Four: She stopped blank meat in twenty twenty.
scenes.say_uz: Bir: Oldin futbol o‘ynardim, endi o‘ynamayman. Ikki: Dadam o‘tgan yili chekishni tashladilar. Uch: Qahvani kamaytirmoqchiman. To‘rt: U 2020-yilda go‘sht yeyishni to‘xtatdi.

scenes.title: Javoblar
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I used to play football”, chunki bu oldingi, hozir yo‘q odat. Ikkinchi: “gave up”, “give” ning o‘tgan zamoni “gave”. Uchinchi: “cut down on coffee”, bu frazali fe’lda ikkita kichik so‘z bor, “on” ni unutmang. To‘rtinchi: “stopped eating”. Agar “stopped to eat” desangiz, u ovqat yeyish uchun to‘xtagan bo‘lib chiqadi.
scenes.say: I used to play football. My dad gave up smoking. I want to cut down on coffee. She stopped eating meat.
scenes.say_uz: Oldin futbol o‘ynardim. Dadam chekishni tashladilar. Qahvani kamaytirmoqchiman. U go‘sht yeyishni to‘xtatdi.

scenes.title: Sabab va natija: because, so
board: I feel tired because I didn't sleep. / because of stress.

examples.t: I'm tired because I didn't sleep well.
I didn't sleep well, so I'm tired.

scenes.say_native: To‘rtinchi mavzu: sabab va natija. “Because” dan keyin to‘liq gap keladi, ya’ni ega va fe’l: “because I didn’t sleep”. “Because of” dan keyin esa faqat ot yoki ot birikmasi: “because of stress”, “because of the heat”. “So” natijani bildiradi va odatda vergul bilan keladi: “I didn’t sleep, so I’m tired”. O‘zbek tilida sabab ko‘pincha fe’lga qo‘shimcha bilan qo‘shiladi: “uxlamaganim uchun”. Ingliz tilida esa alohida bog‘lovchi so‘z kerak va tartib erkinroq.
scenes.say: I'm tired because I didn't sleep well. I'm tired because of stress. I didn't sleep well, so I'm tired today.
scenes.say_uz: Yaxshi uxlamaganim uchun charchadim. Stress tufayli charchadim. Yaxshi uxlamadim, shuning uchun bugun charchaganman.

scenes.title: Lead to, cause, as a result
board: A leads to B / A causes B
too much sugar → leads to weight gain
A is good / bad for B

examples.t: Too much sugar can lead to weight gain.
examples.uz: Ortiqcha shakar vazn ortishiga olib kelishi mumkin.

examples.t: Stress causes headaches.

scenes.say_native: B1 darajasida sabab-natijani rasmiyroq ham ifodalay olishingiz kerak. “Lead to” — olib kelmoq: “Lack of sleep leads to poor concentration”. “Cause” — sabab bo‘lmoq: “Stress causes headaches”. Ikkalasidan keyin ot keladi. Yangi gapni boshlash uchun “As a result” — natijada, og‘zaki nutqda esa “That’s why” — shuning uchun. Yana bir oddiy usul: “be good for” va “be bad for”: “Walking is good for your heart.” Bu iboralar yozma ishlarda, masalan uy vazifangizda juda foydali.
scenes.say: Lack of sleep leads to poor concentration. Stress can cause headaches. I started walking every day. As a result, I've got more energy. That's why I feel so good.
scenes.say_uz: Uyqu yetishmasligi diqqatning pasayishiga olib keladi. Stress bosh og‘rig‘iga sabab bo‘lishi mumkin. Har kuni piyoda yurishni boshladim. Natijada quvvatim ko‘paydi. Shuning uchun o‘zimni juda yaxshi his qilyapman.

scenes.title: If va make
board: If you + hozirgi zamon, you + hozirgi zamon (umumiy haqiqat)
If you don't sleep, you can't concentrate.
make + kishi + sifat: Coffee makes me nervous.
make + kishi + fe’l: It makes me feel better.

examples.t: If you exercise, you sleep better.
Exercise makes me feel happy.

scenes.say_native: Yana ikki kuchli vosita. Birinchisi: “if” bilan umumiy haqiqat. Agar natija har doim shunday bo‘lsa, ikkala qismda ham hozirgi oddiy zamon: “If you exercise, you sleep better”. Aniq kelajak natijasi uchun “will”: “If you go to bed now, you’ll feel better tomorrow”. Ikkinchisi: “make” fe’li. “Coffee makes me nervous” — qahva meni asabiy qiladi. “Make” dan keyin kishi va sifat yoki fe’lning “to” siz shakli keladi: “It makes me feel better”.
scenes.say: If you don't drink enough water, you get headaches. If you go to bed now, you'll feel better tomorrow. Sugar makes me sleepy, but a short walk makes me feel awake.
scenes.say_uz: Yetarlicha suv ichmasangiz, boshingiz og‘riydi. Hozir yotsangiz, ertaga o‘zingizni yaxshiroq his qilasiz. Shakar meni uyqusiratadi, qisqa sayr esa meni tetiklashtiradi.

scenes.title: Sabab-natijadagi xatolar
board: ✗ because of I was ill → ✓ because I was ill
✗ It makes me to feel tired. → ✓ It makes me feel tired.
✗ It causes to gain weight. → ✓ It causes weight gain.
✗ So that I'm tired. → ✓ So I'm tired. / That's why I'm tired.
scenes.say_native: Tipik xatolar. Birinchi: “because of” dan keyin gap qo‘yish. “Because of I was ill” xato, to‘g‘risi “because I was ill” yoki “because of my illness”. Ikkinchi: “makes me to feel”. “Make” dan keyin “to” ishlatilmaydi. Uchinchi: “causes to gain weight”. To‘g‘risi “causes weight gain” yoki “causes you to gain weight”, ya’ni “cause” dan keyin ot yoki kishi va “to” bilan fe’l. To‘rtinchi: natija uchun “so that” emas, oddiy “so” yoki “that’s why” ishlatiladi; “so that” maqsadni bildiradi.
scenes.say: I stayed at home because I was ill. Long working hours make me feel tired. Too much sugar causes weight gain.
scenes.say_uz: Kasal bo‘lganim uchun uyda qoldim. Uzoq ish soatlari meni charchatadi. Ortiqcha shakar vazn ortishiga sabab bo‘ladi.

scenes.title: Gaplarni bog‘lang
board: 1) I didn't have breakfast. I felt hungry all morning. (so)
2) She can't sleep ___ stress. (because / because of)
3) Too much screen time ___ poor sleep. (lead to)
scenes.say_native: Mashq. Birinchi gapda ikki qisqa gapni “so” bilan bitta gapga birlashtiring. Ikkinchisida “because” yoki “because of” ni tanlang. Uchinchisida “lead to” ni to‘g‘ri shaklda qo‘ying, bu umumiy haqiqat. To‘rtinchisida “make” bilan gap tuzing, hozirgi oddiy zamonda.
scenes.say: Join the sentences, choose the right linker, and make a sentence with 'make'. You've got a few seconds. Go!
scenes.say_uz: Gaplarni bog‘lang, to‘g‘ri bog‘lovchini tanlang va “make” bilan gap tuzing. Bir necha soniyangiz bor. Boshlang!

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) I didn't have breakfast, so I felt hungry all morning.
3) Too much screen time leads to poor sleep.
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “I didn’t have breakfast, so I felt hungry all morning”, vergulga e’tibor bering. Ikkinchi: “because of stress”, chunki “stress” ot, undan keyin gap yo‘q. Uchinchi: “Too much screen time leads to poor sleep”, “screen time” birlikda, shuning uchun “leads”, oxirida “s” bor. To‘rtinchi: “Coffee makes me nervous”, “makes” ham “s” bilan, va “to” yo‘q.
scenes.say: I didn't have breakfast, so I felt hungry all morning. She can't sleep because of stress. Too much screen time leads to poor sleep. Coffee makes me nervous.
scenes.say_uz: Nonushta qilmadim, shuning uchun ertalab bo‘yi och yurdim. U stress tufayli uxlay olmaydi. Ortiqcha ekran vaqti yomon uyquga olib keladi. Qahva meni asabiy qiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2: Ikki do‘st
scenes.say_native: Ikkinchi dialog. Malika uzoq vaqtdan beri ko‘rmagan do‘sti Tom bilan uchrashib qoldi. Tom o‘zgarib ketgan. Tinglang: Tom qanday o‘zgardi va nega bunday qaror qildi? “Used to”, frazali fe’llar va sabab-natija iboralariga e’tibor bering. Yangi ibora: “live on pizza” — faqat pitsa bilan kun ko‘rmoq, ya’ni deyarli boshqa narsa yemaslik. “Fizzy drinks” — gazli ichimliklar.
scenes.say: Malika: Tom! You look great! What's your secret? Tom: Thanks! Well, I used to work until midnight and live on pizza. Last winter I got really ill, and my doctor said it was because of stress and a poor diet. So I decided to change. I took up cycling, gave up fizzy drinks and started cooking at home. Malika: And how do you feel now? Tom: Much better. I've lost six kilos, and I'm sleeping like a baby. Honestly, if you change just one habit, it makes a big difference.
scenes.say_uz: Malika: Tom! Ajoyib ko‘rinyapsan! Siring nima? Tom: Rahmat! Oldin yarim tungacha ishlardim va faqat pitsa bilan kun ko‘rardim. O‘tgan qishda qattiq kasal bo‘ldim, shifokorim bunga stress va yomon ovqatlanish sabab dedi. Shuning uchun o‘zgarishga qaror qildim. Velosiped haydashni boshladim, gazli ichimliklarni tashladim va uyda ovqat pishirishni boshladim. Malika: Hozir o‘zingni qanday his qilyapsan? Tom: Ancha yaxshi. Olti kilo yo‘qotdim va chaqaloqdek uxlayapman. Rostini aytsam, bitta odatni o‘zgartirsang ham, katta farq qiladi.

scenes.title: Dialog 2 bo‘yicha savollar
board: 1) What did Tom use to do?
3) What three changes did he make?
scenes.say_native: Savollarga javob bering. Tom oldin qanday yashardi? Nega u kasal bo‘ldi? U qanday uchta o‘zgarish qildi? Natijasi qanday bo‘ldi? Javob berishda “used to”, “because of” va frazali fe’llarni ishlatishga harakat qiling. Masalan, uchinchi savolga “He took up…” deb boshlashingiz mumkin. Javobni qisqa, lekin to‘liq gap bilan ayting.
scenes.say: What did Tom use to do? Why did he get ill? What three changes did he make? What are the results?
scenes.say_uz: Tom oldin nima qilardi? Nega kasal bo‘ldi? Qanday uchta o‘zgarish qildi? Natijalar qanday?

scenes.title: Javoblar: dialog 2
board: 1) He used to work until midnight and live on pizza.
2) because of stress and a poor diet
3) took up cycling · gave up fizzy drinks · started cooking
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: u yarim tungacha ishlardi va pitsa bilan kun ko‘rardi, “live on” — faqat shu bilan ovqatlanmoq degani. Ikkinchi: stress va yomon ovqatlanish tufayli. Uchinchi: velosipedni boshladi, gazli ichimliklarni tashladi, uyda ovqat pishira boshladi. To‘rtinchi: olti kilo yo‘qotdi va juda yaxshi uxlayapti. “Sleep like a baby” — chaqaloqdek, ya’ni juda tinch uxlamoq degan ibora.
scenes.say: He used to work until midnight and live on pizza. He got ill because of stress and a poor diet. He took up cycling, gave up fizzy drinks and started cooking. He's lost six kilos and sleeps like a baby.
scenes.say_uz: U yarim tungacha ishlardi va pitsa bilan kun ko‘rardi. Stress va yomon ovqatlanish tufayli kasal bo‘ldi. Velosipedni boshladi, gazli ichimliklarni tashladi va ovqat pishira boshladi. Olti kilo yo‘qotdi va chaqaloqdek uxlayapti.

scenes.title: Tabiiy nutq: frazali fe’l va olmosh
board: give up smoking → give it up ✓
cut down on sugar → cut down on it

examples.t: Smoking is bad. Give it up!
I took it up last year.

scenes.say_native: Tabiiy nutq uchun ikki nozik jihat. Birinchisi grammatik: “give up”, “take up” kabi fe’llarda olmosh o‘rtaga kiradi: “give it up”, “take it up”. “Give up it” deyish xato. Lekin “cut down on” kabi uch qismli fe’llarda olmosh oxirida qoladi: “cut down on it”. Ikkinchisi talaffuz: ona tilida so‘zlashuvchilar bu so‘zlarni ulab aytadi. “Gave up” — “gei-vap”, “cut down on” — so‘zlar orasida to‘xtash yo‘q. “Give it up” esa “gi-vi-tap” kabi eshitiladi. Tinglaganda buni bilish juda yordam beradi.
scenes.say: Smoking? I gave it up years ago. Sugar? I'm trying to cut down on it. Swimming? I took it up last summer.
scenes.say_uz: Chekishmi? Uni yillar oldin tashlaganman. Shakarmi? Uni kamaytirishga harakat qilyapman. Suzishmi? Uni o‘tgan yozda boshlaganman.

scenes.title: Xatoni toping
board: 1) You should to go to bed earlier.  2) I use to eat a lot of bread.
3) Junk food makes me to feel sleepy.
4) I gave up it last year.
5) I can't run because of my knee hurts.
scenes.say_native: Aralash mashq. Bu beshta gapning har birida bittadan xato bor. Ularni toping va to‘g‘ri variantini baland ovozda ayting. Bugun o‘rgangan hamma qoidalar shu yerda: maslahat, “used to”, “make”, frazali fe’l va “because of”. Shoshilmang, har bir gapni ichingizda o‘qib, qaysi qoidaga tegishli ekanini o‘ylang, keyin to‘g‘ri shaklini ayting.
scenes.say: Find the mistake in each sentence and say the correct version.
scenes.say_uz: Har bir gapdagi xatoni toping va to‘g‘ri variantini ayting.

scenes.title: Javoblar
board: 1) should go  2) I used to eat
5) because my knee hurts / because of my bad knee
scenes.say_native: Javoblar. Birinchi: “should” dan keyin “to” yo‘q. Ikkinchi: o‘tmishdagi odat uchun “I used to”. Uchinchi: “makes me feel”, “to” siz. To‘rtinchi: “I gave it up”, olmosh o‘rtada. Beshinchi: “because my knee hurts”, chunki keyin to‘liq gap bor, yoki “because of my bad knee”. Agar beshtadan to‘rttasini topgan bo‘lsangiz, zo‘r natija!
scenes.say: You should go to bed earlier. I used to eat a lot of bread. Junk food makes me feel sleepy. I gave it up last year. I can't run because my knee hurts.
scenes.say_uz: Ertaroq yotishingiz kerak. Oldin ko‘p non yerdim. Zararli ovqat meni uyqusiratadi. Uni o‘tgan yili tashladim. Tizzam og‘riyotgani uchun yugura olmayman.

scenes.title: Foydali qo‘shimcha iboralar
board: get some fresh air (toza havoda yurmoq)

examples.t: I sit at a desk all day, so I try to take the stairs.
examples.uz: Kun bo‘yi stol yonida o‘tiraman, shuning uchun zinadan chiqishga harakat qilaman.

scenes.say_native: Nutqingizni boyitadigan yana bir nechta tayyor ibora. “Get some fresh air” — toza havoga chiqmoq. “Take the stairs” — liftga emas, zinadan chiqmoq. “A sedentary lifestyle” — kam harakatli, o‘tirib ishlanadigan hayot tarzi; bu so‘z sog‘liq haqidagi maqolalarda juda ko‘p uchraydi. “Everything in moderation” — hamma narsa me’yorida bo‘lsin, degan maqol. Bizda ham “har narsaning me’yori bor” deymiz. Bu iboralarni uy vazifangizda albatta ishlating.
scenes.say: Many of us have a sedentary lifestyle. We sit at work, sit in the car and sit in front of the TV. So take the stairs, get some fresh air at lunchtime, and remember: everything in moderation.
scenes.say_uz: Ko‘pchiligimiz kam harakatli hayot kechiramiz. Ishda o‘tiramiz, mashinada o‘tiramiz, televizor oldida o‘tiramiz. Shuning uchun zinadan chiqing, tushlikda toza havoga chiqing va eslang: hamma narsa me’yorida.

scenes.title: Gapirish: sizning odatlaringiz
board: 2) One thing you used to do
4) One piece of advice for a friend
scenes.say_native: Endi asosiy og‘zaki topshiriq. Bir daqiqa davomida o‘zingiz haqingizda gapiring. Rejaga qarang: ikkita hozirgi odatingiz, oldin qilgan, endi qilmaydigan bitta narsangiz, qilgan bitta o‘zgarishingiz va uning natijasi, oxirida do‘stingizga bitta maslahat. Agar istasangiz, gapingizni telefoningizga yozib oling.
scenes.say: Now it's your turn. Talk about your habits, a change you've made and its result, and give one piece of advice. Ready? Start!
scenes.say_uz: Endi navbat sizda. Odatlaringiz, qilgan o‘zgarishingiz va uning natijasi haqida gapiring va bitta maslahat bering. Tayyormisiz? Boshlang!

scenes.title: Namuna javob
scenes.say_native: Mana bir namuna javob, uni tinglang va o‘zingiznikiga solishtiring. E’tibor bering, namuna qisqa, lekin unda bugungi to‘rtta mavzuning hammasi bor: odatlar, “used to”, o‘zgarish va natija, va maslahat. Agar sizning javobingizda ham shu to‘rt qism bo‘lgan bo‘lsa, topshiriqni a’lo bajardingiz.
scenes.say: I usually walk to work, and I tend to drink a lot of tea. I used to stay up really late, but now I go to bed at eleven. I've also cut down on sugar, and as a result I've got much more energy in the afternoon. My advice? If I were you, I'd start with sleep, because everything is easier when you're not tired.
scenes.say_uz: Odatda ishga piyoda boraman va ko‘p choy ichishga moyilman. Oldin juda kech yotardim, endi esa soat o‘n birda yotaman. Shakarni ham kamaytirdim, natijada tushdan keyin ancha ko‘proq quvvatim bor. Maslahatimmi? Men sizning o‘rningizda bo‘lsam, uyqudan boshlardim, chunki charchamaganingizda hamma narsa osonroq.

scenes.title: Bugun nimani o‘rgandik
board: diet · exercise (do / play / go) · sleep (go to bed / fall asleep)
should · ought to · 'd better · Why don't you…? · If I were you…
usually · tend to · used to · give up · cut down on · take up
because / because of · so · lead to · cause · make me feel
scenes.say_native: Xulosa qilamiz. Ovqatlanish, sport va uyqu lug‘atini o‘rgandik: “do exercise”, “play football”, “go swimming”, “go to bed” va “fall asleep” farqi. Maslahat berish uchun “should”, “ought to”, kuchli “’d better” va muloyim “Why don’t you”, “How about -ing”, “If I were you” iboralarini ko‘rdik. Odatlar uchun chastota ravishlari, “tend to”, “used to” va frazali fe’llarni o‘rgandik. Sabab-natija uchun “because”, “because of”, “so”, “lead to”, “cause” va “make” ni ishlatdik.
scenes.say: Great job today! You can now talk about diet, exercise and sleep, give advice in several ways, describe habits and changes, and explain causes and effects.
scenes.say_uz: Bugun zo‘r ishladingiz! Endi ovqatlanish, sport va uyqu haqida gapira olasiz, turli usullarda maslahat bera olasiz, odatlar va o‘zgarishlarni tasvirlay olasiz hamda sabab va natijani tushuntira olasiz.

scenes.title: Uyga vazifa
board: Write advice for a healthier lifestyle (100 words)
scenes.say_native: Uyga vazifa. Sog‘lomroq hayot kechirmoqchi bo‘lgan do‘stingizga yuz so‘zli maslahat yozing. Unda ovqatlanish, sport va uyqu haqida kamida bittadan maslahat bo‘lsin. Muvaffaqiyat mezoni: kamida uch xil maslahat tuzilmasi, masalan “should”, “Why don’t you” va “If I were you”, hamda kamida ikkita sabab-natija bog‘lovchisi, masalan “because” va “so”. Yozib bo‘lgach, “should to” va “makes me to” xatolari yo‘qligini tekshiring. Keyingi darsda atrof-muhit va ekologiya haqida gaplashamiz.
scenes.say: Write about one hundred words of advice for a friend who wants to live a healthier life. See you next time!
scenes.say_uz: Sog‘lomroq hayot kechirmoqchi bo‘lgan do‘stingizga yuz so‘zga yaqin maslahat yozing. Keyingi darsda ko‘rishguncha!

homework_uz: Sog‘lomroq hayot kechirmoqchi bo‘lgan do‘stingizga 100 so‘zli maslahat yozing: ovqatlanish, sport va uyqu haqida kamida bittadan maslahat. Mezon: kamida 3 xil maslahat tuzilmasi (should, Why don't you…?, If I were you, I'd…) va kamida 2 ta sabab-natija bog‘lovchisi (because, so, lead to); “should to” va “makes me to” xatolari yo‘q.

options: I play sport yoga every day.
quiz.why_uz: Ingliz tilida “make sport” yo‘q; “do sport” yoki “do exercise” deymiz.

quiz.q: You look really tired. You ___ go to bed earlier.
How about ___ for a walk after dinner?
quiz.why_uz: “How about” dan keyin fe’l “-ing” shaklda keladi.

quiz.q: Which sentence is a strong warning?
options: You'd better see a doctor now.
It's a good idea to rest.
quiz.why_uz: “’d better” — kuchli maslahat, aks holda muammo bo‘ladi degan ma’no.

quiz.q: I ___ eat a lot of sweets, but now I don't.
quiz.why_uz: O‘tmishdagi, hozir yo‘q odat uchun “used to” ishlatiladi.

quiz.q: My grandfather stopped ___ ten years ago. He's much healthier now.
quiz.why_uz: “Stop smoking” — chekishni tashlamoq; “stop to smoke” — chekish uchun to‘xtamoq.

quiz.q: I'm trying to cut down ___ sugar.

quiz.why_uz: “The noise” — ot, otdan oldin “because of” keladi.

quiz.q: Coffee in the evening makes me ___ nervous.
Yesterday I went to bed at 11, but I didn't ___ until 1 a.m.
quiz.why_uz: Uyquga ketish payti uchun “fall asleep” ishlatiladi; “go to bed” — yotmoq.
